frame: Frame: east-north-up metres (x east, y north, z up), origin on the ground below the source camera (labeler LocalFrame at the source pano); z = 0 is flat ground and each camera sits at its 'auto' height. Camera poses are camera-to-world 4x4 with OpenCV camera axes (x right, y down, z forward). Rays: origin + t * dir, t >= 0.
inference: memory_efficient, bf16, intrinsics + pose priors, metric
